edits: Submit a Run directly to an enabled sleeping Worker, then observe the accepted Run's status/result and queue deadline. Reading a Worker does not wake it. The existing `queue_if_busy: false` prevents same-Worktree follow-ups; it does **not** disable Worker-capacity queuing. Independent Worktrees may share capacity concurrently. Full cognition/reflection use fresh Sessions. The current World Agent also receives a fresh remote Session for each paid turn or selected stage, with permitted application continuity; its durable conversation and funding identity persist without reusing remote model history. A changed tool profile additionally selects a fresh Worktree after earlier exposure is reconciled. Follow the [current owner-conversation contract](world-agent-runtime.md#scoped-context-and-native-save-for-review), rather than restoring the earlier retained-Session behavior.
files.summary: align creator turns with fresh remote Sessions and durable application continuity
